content_metadata.description: A video featuring Joe Selvaggi, a political candidate, interviewed by Mike Cann and Heather Mack about his views on marijuana legalization. The video explores different perspectives on the topic through an engaging debate.

qAndA.answer: Joe said he had severe asthma.
qAndA.question: What medical condition did Joe Selvaggi say he had as a child?
What medical device did Mike Cann mention some marijuana users use instead of smoking?

qAndA.answer: Alcohol use at a young age.
qAndA.question: According to Heather, what did a recent study identify as a common indicator of later drug abuse?

qAndA.answer: Joe is wearing a light blue, long-sleeved button-down shirt.
qAndA.question: What type of apparel is Joe Selvaggi wearing in the video?

qAndA.answer: The mood is positive because Mike Cann celebrates Joe’s open-mindedness, suggesting that their conversation has made a positive impact. The video fades out on Joe smiling, suggesting he is receptive to further discussion.
qAndA.question: Why is the mood at the end of the video positive, despite Joe Selvaggi not taking a firm stance on the topic discussed?

activities.description: Joe Selvaggi responds to Mike's question about marijuana legalization

characterInteraction.description: Mike plays the interviewer, pushing Joe to clarify his stance, while Joe diplomatically avoids a clear position.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Joe’s personal anecdote about his asthma could be seen as an attempt to relate to voters with health concerns.

mood.description: Neutral/Pensive. Joe appears thoughtful as he responds to the question, but avoids taking a firm stance.

Joe shares a personal anecdote about his asthma.

Joe and Mike engage in a debate about the issue
